provenance.label: MaleCNS-grounded premotor representation
provenance.mapping_verification_note: flyvis->MaleCNS drive = MaleCNS v1.0-typed presynaptic partners weighted by synapse count (connectome-grounded). verified=True means the classes synapse onto the receptor in MaleCNS v1.0, NOT that flyvis responses equal MaleCNS recordings.
provenance.weight_rule: positive synapse counts / total incoming synapses; gain=1.25; signs unavailable in this cache
provenance.sensory: pretrained FlyVis flow/0000/000; stateful world camera input
provenance.sensory_mapping: canonical synapse-weighted class means; single eye applied bilaterally
provenance.embodiment: engineered kinematic wheelchair; FlyGym not integrated
provenance.controller: baseline-relative suppression detector; one bounded maneuver, bilateral reconstructed change sets engineered direction; no biological steering claim

training.source: world camera -> pretrained FlyVis -> sparse LIF -> independent ungated DNp01 model

evaluation.note: Held-out modeled trials with fixed body. No behavioral validation, calibrated confidence or causal biological direction.

trial_result.reference: Independent ungated model driven by the same live retinal input; not biological ground truth.
